g.text: This database appears to be designed for a knowledge management system focusing on topics, personnel, events, and organizations.
Core entities include Topics, Personnel (experts/key figures), Events, Organizations, Testimonies, Documents, and Sightings.
Junction tables manage many-to-many relationships between these entities (e.g., connecting experts to topics or events).
User-related tables allow saving references to all core entities and connecting them to user-created theories.
The system includes vector embeddings (in Documents and Mindmaps tables) likely for semantic search capabilities.
